shelterAttackThoughts: …I feel something is wrong, I need to return to the shelter…
…The shelter seems to be in danger, I need to go back…
…Something is wrong, I must return to the shelter immediately…
…Someone has breached the magical barrier, I must return to the shelter urgently…
…The magical trap was destroyed, I need to return to the shelter…
…A sense of alarm… Something is happening at the shelter, I need to check…
…Strangers in the hideout! I must hurry back…
…The shelter's protective barrier is fading… I must make it back…
…The link to the shelter has been severed… Something happened there, I must return!
…Everything inside me tightened… Something is suppressing my magic at the shelter, I must hurry back…
…This chill on my skin… Our hideout is under attack, I must return!…
victoryThoughts: …It's over… They withdrew. It's safe here again…
defeatThoughts: …It's over. The barriers fell—they will take the shelter…
timeoutThoughts: …I'm too late… The shelter couldn't hold without me…
…Too late… While I was away, they reached the children…
